description: This header file declares an interface for implementing filesystem monitoring listener backend for the fsmonitor system. It contains function prototypes for initialization, cleanup, event loop, and shutdown of the listener thread, conditioned on the presence of a specific backend.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Contains the main event loop for filesystem event monitoring, runs in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests a graceful shutdown of the listener thread without waiting for it to terminate.
